title: Polynomial identity test witness predicate
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be the first components obtained by applying the pair decoder twice to $z$. The predicate returns true exactly when either $a$ or $b$ is not a valid witness, their encoded head lengths differ, or the pipeline rejects the nested pair encoding formed from their heads, scan results, tails, and the final bit $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a list of Boolean values
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the pair decoders, witness validator, scan operation, pairing encoding, or pipeline, so their exact mathematical meanings cannot be made self-contained.
